gain_formula: runtime.shinobi_runtime.martial_world.training.training_gain_milli; current skill raises point cost continuously but never makes gain impossible

instructor_capacity.hierarchy_rule: chief instructors may supervise subordinate instructors; each subordinate separately supplies its own group capacity, so there is no artificial faction-wide unit cap

combat_evidence_rule: combat and difficult field work create development evidence/novelty; training, reflection or instruction converts that evidence through the same progression formula rather than granting arbitrary instant skill points
representation_parity: Full Character, Person Lite and aggregate-derived recruits use the same progression law.
